description: Validate a design session (or one page) in draft or complete mode. Returns totals plus paginated diagnostics. A plan-ready graph is not proof of rendered correctness.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor if validation diagnostics exceed single response limit.

designId.description: Identifier of the design session to validate.

mode.description: Validation strictness mode: "draft" allows unbound slots; "complete" enforces zero open slots and full port connectivity.

pageId.description: Optionally scope validation to a single page within the session.

revision.description: Specific revision to validate (defaults to latest).

name: validate_design
